  "overall_experience": "This Office Manager likely found BambooHR to be a significant upgrade for managing HR processes in their small business. The platform's ease of use and ability to centralize employee data were highly beneficial, streamlining tasks that were previously manual. While robust for core HR, they may have encountered minor frustrations with payroll integration or felt the cost was substantial for their company size."
